findings.title: Parenthesize the OR-based authorization predicate before returning it
findings.body: For team/org scopes with members and no optional filters, authConditions is an unparenthesized `A OR B` expression. Returning it directly makes normal raw-query composition unsafe: `WHERE ${baseConditions} AND "startTime" >= ${from}` becomes `A OR (B AND dateConstraint)`, so the team-booking branch bypasses the date constraint. Placing additional constraints before the fragment instead leaves the personal-booking branch unconstrained. Wrap the returned authorization predicate in parentheses and test composition with an additional WHERE constraint for team/org scopes without optional filters.
